target_policy: All current and future targets remain uncorrupted source reference trajectories
amplitude_convention: Translation is actual 3D displacement norm in mm; rotation is actual SO(3) geodesic angle in degrees, never per-axis std or noise added to rot6d
amplitude_sampling: Uniform radius/angle within selected range; isotropic random direction; group rotations composed on SO(3)

temporal_noise.history_current_joint_process: shared continuous noise where case permits; explicit reset at current time in current_reanchors_history
temporal_noise.bounded_rule: Normalize direction after any mixing, then multiply by bounded radius/angle. Do not add multiple full-amplitude errors.
temporal_noise.actual_correlation: Must be measured after direction normalization; latent OU rho is not the final error correlation

quality.oracle_quality: optional separately labeled ablation only; not the default condition

source_sampling: retain current four-source split and sampling; no new images required
limitations: Not fitted to HaWoR empirical error distribution; all amplitudes and mixture weights are unvalidated starting hypotheses
Five percent strong-case sampling is not a guarantee that only five percent of candidate/model joint errors are large; missing-value hold and rotation/FK coupling can add error
Clean restoration may be copied; future labels and dedicated restoration conditions remain necessary
No trainer or model architecture is changed by this proposal file; the user-paused run remains stopped
